{{Top|leg|title=z23 heat dissipation unit}}
The '''z23 heat dissipation unit''' was a [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] product designed to control the temperatures within modified [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] [[Dune Walker]]s for missions over [[Desert/Legends|desert]] terrain.
